description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing Woodfall Primus.
When Woodfall Primus dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Thran Vigil, Blasting Station and Woodfall Primus trigger.
Resolve the Blasting Station trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Thran Vigil trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Woodfall Primus.
Resolve the Woodfall Primus trigger, destroying target noncreature permanent.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1
Repeat.
